from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


def junit(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    root = ET.parse(path).getroot()
    suite = root if root.tag == "testsuite" else root.find("testsuite")
    if suite is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No testsuite found in {path}")
    return {
        "tests": int(suite.attrib.get("tests", 0)),
        "failures": int(suite.attrib.get("failures", 0)),
        "errors": int(suite.attrib.get("errors", 0)),
        "skipped": int(suite.attrib.get("skipped", 0)),
        "time_seconds": float(suite.attrib.get("time", 0.0)),
    }


def status_map(evidence: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
    statuses: dict[str, int] = {}
    for line in (evidence / "status.tsv").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        name, code = line.split("\t")
        statuses[name] = int(code)
    return statuses


def log_tails(evidence: Path, statuses: dict[str, int]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    tails: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for name, code in statuses.items():
        if code == 0:
            continue
        log = evidence / f"{name}.log"
        if log.exists():
            tails[name] = log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()[-160:]
    return tails


def coverage(path: Path) -> float:
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return float(data["totals"]["percent_covered"])


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--decision", choices=("PASS", "FAIL"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    evidence = args.evidence
    statuses = status_map(evidence)
    base: dict[str, Any] = {
        "schema": "aspenops.cache-write-efficiency-result/v1"
        if args.decision == "PASS"
        else "aspenops.cache-write-efficiency-blocker/v1",
        "decision": args.decision,
        "hard_gates": statuses,
        "runtime_control_plane_changed": False,
        "aspen_executed": False,
        "parameter_estimation_executed": False,
        "dynamic_modeling_executed": False,
        "machine_learning_executed": False,
        "qualification_boundary": (
            "Pure Python bulk cache payload encoding and portable package evidence; "
            "not licensed Aspen solve certification."
        ),
        "qualification_run": {
            "run_id": os.environ.get("RUN_ID", ""),
            "run_attempt": os.environ.get("RUN_ATTEMPT", ""),
        },
        "rejected_candidates": [
            "Explicit multi-deepcopy EvaluationResult serializer: 0.658x legacy performance.",
            "JSON-aware EvaluationResult recursion: 0.587x legacy performance.",
        ],
    }
    if args.decision == "FAIL":
        base.update(
            {
                "source_changes_retained": False,
                "failure_tail": log_tails(evidence, statuses),
            }
        )
        Path("docs/CACHE_WRITE_EFFICIENCY_BLOCKER.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(base, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        return

    benchmark = json.loads((evidence / "benchmark.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    base.update(
        {
            "benchmark": benchmark,
            "focused_tests": junit(evidence / "focused-junit.xml"),
            "full_tests": {
                version: junit(evidence / f"junit-{version}.xml")
                for version in ("3.11", "3.12", "3.13")
            },
            "coverage_percent": {
                version: coverage(evidence / f"coverage-{version}.json")
                for version in ("3.11", "3.12", "3.13")
            },
            "preserved_contracts": [
                "exact compact JSON bytes and key ordering",
                "Unicode output and allow_nan=False rejection",
                "ResultCache put_many/get_many round trip",
                "hit accounting, memory LRU and SQLite transaction semantics",
                "worker and runtime control semantics",
            ],
            "source_files_changed": [
                "src/aspenops_nexus/cache.py",
                "tests/test_cache_write_efficiency.py",
            ],
            "external_gate": "PENDING_LICENSED_WINDOWS_ASPEN_ENGINEERING_CERTIFICATION",
        }
    )
    Path("docs/CACHE_WRITE_EFFICIENCY_RESULT.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(base, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    Path("docs/CACHE_WRITE_EFFICIENCY_RESULT.md").write_text(
        "# AspenOps Cache Write Efficiency Audit\n\n"
        "**PASS**\n\n"
        f"- Bulk payload encoding speedup: {benchmark['speedup']:.3f}x\n"
        "- Compact JSON bytes, Unicode and NaN rejection: unchanged\n"
        "- SQLite and memory-cache round trip: PASS\n"
        "- Two slower result-serialization candidates: rejected and rolled back\n"
        "- Licensed Windows/Aspen engineering certification: pending\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
